items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: They listened to mainstream adult pop music. So I mean they would have on the radio what the records of the time were, maybe Sinatra things or Tony Bennett or Barbra Streisand

ctx.x: I’ll be darned. That’s a great moment. What about radio? Did it have any impact on you?

Oh yeah. Well my parents would listen to the radio every morning when we were getting ready for school and all that stuff, and it was AM radio at the time. I mean the stations they listened to, my parents were very non-rock & roll. They listened to mainstream adult pop music. So I mean they would have on the radio what the records of the time were, maybe Sinatra things or Tony Bennett or Barbra Streisand, or whatever was in the air at the time. So I got exposed to a lot of that. And you know I mean I had good…
Can I guess that your parents looked askance at a music career?
